content: Finally, we use LV-N, LV-M, and FT to generate OOV word representations for the following words: 1) “hellooo”: a greeting commonly used in instant messaging which emphasizes a syllable. 2) “marvelicious”: a made-up word obtained by merging “marvelous” and “delicious”. 3) “louisana”: a misspelling of the proper name “Louisiana”. 4) “rereread”: recursive use of prefix “re”. 5) “tuzread”: made-up prefix “tuz”.
